title: Stop subclassing for every notifier combo

task.text: A new option should add one class, not double the list of subclasses.
`Notifiers.create(tag, shout, out)` must keep returning a `Notifier` that behaves exactly as now. Replace the per-combination subclasses with **decorators** over `Notifier`.

items: Add `Prefixing(Notifier next, String tag)`: sends `[tag] message`.
Add `Shouting(Notifier next)`: sends the message in upper case.
Delete the three combination classes and `ListNotifierBase`.
`create` stacks the decorators; the tag keeps its case, so `Shouting` is the outer one.

checks.title: No options sends the message as is
Tag and shout combine as before
Prefixing and Shouting each wrap a Notifier
Decorators wrap a Notifier they have never seen
create builds one base and stacks on it

hints.text: Find what varies independently: adding a tag and shouting. Each is one small behaviour that could wrap any `Notifier` and still be a `Notifier`.
Write `Prefixing` and `Shouting` as `Notifier`s with a `private final Notifier next`. Each changes the message and calls `next.send(...)`. `create` builds a `ListNotifier` and wraps it.

lines: if (tag != null) n = new Prefixing(n, tag);
